entries.logic_thesis: Human destiny and social order in the Min region are patterned by karmic debt, spirit intervention, and the moral quality of action, so historical misfortune and personal fortune must be read as consequence rather than accident.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Local history is staged as a moral cosmos where ghosts, immortals, and officials enforce balance. 2) Unsettled injustice or broken vows generate later calamity for households and cities. 3) Correct ritual, filial duty, and restitution re-align Heaven–human relation. 4) Recognition of hidden causes (past life, curse, geomantic offense) is prerequisite to remedy. 5) Narrative revelation functions as proof that fate is legible and improvable. 6) Therefore fortune-telling and chronicle reading share one logic: diagnose root, then repair conduct and timing.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Map chart stems/branches against life events in the story’s causal order (offense → delay → payback). 2) Locate official/ghost pressure as Officer/Seven Kill or void-star emptiness in the luck cycles. 3) Treat ancestral or land disputes as Resource/Storage clashes needing resolution years. 4) Prefer remedies that combine timing (lucky pillar) with moral repair (vow, offering, restitution). 5) Use the text’s ‘reveal then resolve’ pattern: first name the hidden cause in the chart, then prescribe year/month for action.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure doctrinal baojuan that argue universal salvation, 闽都别记 embeds fate logic in regional legend and social drama. Compared with Hongyang scriptures, it is less about Unborn Mother eschatology and more about karmic historiography of place. Versus classic BaZi manuals, it supplies narrative cases rather than abstract ten-god rules.

entries.name_han: 正信除疑无修证自在宝卷
entries.logic_thesis: True faith removes doubt; once false striving and dualistic ‘practice/attainment’ are dropped, the mind is already free and needs no forced cultivation to prove itself.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Doubt is the root obstruction that splits mind into seeker and sought. 2) Formal cultivation that chases signs reinforces that split. 3) Right faith (正信) is trust in original completeness, not belief in external reward. 4) When doubt ceases, ‘no cultivation, no verification’ becomes the mode of ease (自在). 5) Phenomena then self-settle without manufactured effort. 6) Liberation is recognized, not manufactured.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In a chart heavy with Self/Companion and missing stable Resource, treat anxiety as ‘doubt pattern’ rather than only weak body. 2) Soften over-control years (strong Officer/Kill without Seal support) by reducing forced remedies. 3) Use Food/Hurt and Seal combinations as ‘ease indicators’ when they free output without panic. 4) Time counsel for pillars that quiet rivalry and empty false ambitions (void, combine-away of competing gods). 5) Prefer one clarifying principle over many conflicting talismans when the client’s pattern is over-striving.
entries.logic_compare: This baojuan is closer to sudden-enlightenment Chan rhetoric than to Hongyang’s graded Dragon Flower salvation. Against 弘阳悟道明心经, it stresses non-doing more than structured awakening stages. Relative to orthopractic Daoist liturgy texts, it demotes ritual laddering and elevates doubt-removal as the single hinge.

entries.name_han: 巍巍不动太山深根结果宝卷
entries.logic_thesis: Like a great mountain with deep roots, the true nature is immovable; only by rooting in that stillness can practice bear lasting fruit (结果).
entries.logic_chain: 1) Surface motion of mind and world is unstable. 2) The ‘Tai mountain’ image names an unshaken ground of being. 3) Without deep root (正因/本性), all techniques are flowers without fruit. 4) Rooting means return to the unborn, unmoved awareness. 5) From that root, results appear spontaneously as fruition. 6) Thus stability precedes success; agitation cannot force harvest.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Identify the Day Master’s ‘root’ via season, support, and storage—deep root vs floating stems. 2) Treat mountain-stillness as strong Resource/Seal or solid Earth that steadies the self. 3) Read ‘fruit’ as Output/Wealth that only ripens after root years, not during pure shock luck. 4) Avoid prescribing aggressive wealth grabs when the chart is rootless; first rebuild Seal/Resource timing. 5) Use decade luck that consolidates (combine, seal, storage) before harvest luck (wealth, food).
entries.logic_compare: The mountain-root metaphor aligns with quietist Daoist cultivation more than with pure apocalyptic Hongyang mission texts. Compared with 弘阳显性结果经, both speak of ‘results,’ but this volume emphasizes immovability as cause of fruit rather than revelation of nature alone. Versus 闽都别记, it is abstract and soteriological, not historical-karmic narrative.

entries.logic_thesis: From Hunyuan Hongyang origin, the divine descends into the mortal realm (临凡) to rescue the lost; floating in the red dust is the mission field of salvation, not mere exile.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Cosmic origin (混元弘阳) precedes differentiated worlds. 2) Beings fall into samsaric drift through delusion. 3) The sacred person/teaching ‘comes among humans’ as deliberate descent. 4) Suffering of the floating world is the contact zone for conversion. 5) Recognition of the envoy and dharma re-links the fallen to origin. 6) History is therefore a rescue operation structured by heavenly timing.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read ‘descent’ charts as strong Officer/Kill or traveling-star patterns that force worldly entry. 2) Treat exile/float motifs as void, remote travel branches, or Wealth/Official pulls away from home base. 3) Time ‘mission years’ when Seal meets Output—teaching/transmission capacity opens. 4) Distinguish punitive banishment (broken root + killing without seal) from vocation descent (seal + authority with purpose). 5) Align client ‘calling’ narratives with luck cycles that leave the natal comfort zone.
entries.logic_compare: This is a classic Hongyang founding myth text: origin–fall–descent–rescue. It is more cosmogonic and sectarian than 正信除疑’s interior non-dual calm. Compared with 古佛天真考证龙华宝经, it focuses on the Hongyang descent story rather than the full three Dragon Flower assemblies schema.

entries.logic_thesis: Awakening (悟道) is clarifying the mind (明心): when the original mind is seen, the path is complete, and outer confusion no longer defines the person.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Beings possess original mind covered by dust of habit. 2) Study and chant prepare but do not replace seeing. 3) Illumination of mind is direct recognition, not accumulation of merits alone. 4) Once mind is clear, conduct reorganizes around that clarity. 5) Dao is not elsewhere; delusion was mislocation of mind. 6) Therefore teaching aims at insight events timed by readiness.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Use Seal/Resource as ‘mind-light’ gods; their timely arrival favors insight work. 2) Reduce years of pure Peer rivalry and chaotic Output that scatter attention. 3) Mark breakthrough luck as combinations that free the Day Master from smothering or emptiness extremes. 4) Pair meditation/study prescriptions with Seal-supported months, not only Wealth months. 5) Read ‘明心’ as shift from reactive Officer fear to Seal-governed interpretation of events.
entries.logic_compare: Closer to mind-seal Buddhist language than 弘阳叹世经’s lament over worldly vanity. It operationalizes what 混元弘阳临凡飘高经 mythologizes: after descent of teaching comes personal awakening. Against 巍巍不动太山…, it stresses lucid seeing more than immovable rootedness, though both reject restless technique-chasing.

entries.logic_thesis: The world is transient, deceptive, and sorrow-producing; sighing over samsara is the gateway that turns the heart from attachment toward the Hongyang path of exit.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Sensory pleasures and status are unstable. 2) Attachment multiplies grief when conditions reverse. 3) Lament (叹) is not despair but diagnostic clarity. 4) Seeing the world’s bitterness weakens greed and pride. 5) Renunciation energy seeks a reliable refuge and teaching. 6) Thus distaste for the floating world becomes fuel for conversion and practice.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When chart shows repeated Wealth–Officer shocks and broken happiness gods, frame counseling as ‘叹世 realism,’ not mere pessimism. 2) Identify attachment clusters (Wealth + Peer fighting, or Hurt damaging Seal). 3) Time renunciation or life-revision talks in years that dissolve false Wealth/romance combinations. 4) Strengthen Seal and Food for reflective speech rather than impulsive Kill clashes. 5) Convert lament into scheduled practice commitments during supportive decade luck.
entries.logic_compare: Tone is elegiac and pedagogical, unlike the triumphant fruition language of 弘阳显性结果经. It shares world-weariness with many baojuan ‘sigh-for-the-world’ sections but within Hongyang branding. Versus 正信除疑, it still uses emotional aversion as a skillful means rather than immediately declaring non-dual ease.

entries.logic_thesis: Manifesting the true nature (显性) is what brings real fruition (结果); outer ranks and empty titles without nature-revelation are barren.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Latent nature is present but covered. 2) Practice must aim at manifestation, not cosmetics of piety. 3) When nature appears, karmic patterns reorganize. 4) ‘Fruit’ means verified change in being and destiny, not rhetoric. 5) False paths yield flowers without fruit. 6) Therefore criteria of success are disclosure of nature plus stable results in conduct and liberation trajectory.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Define chart ‘nature’ as Day Master quality in season; ‘manifest’ when useful gods become timely and visible. 2) Score ‘结果’ as concrete luck outcomes after a Seal/Output clarification period. 3) Discard remedies that only decorate status (vanity Officer) without supporting the useful god. 4) Sequence: stabilize body/root → reveal useful god → harvest Wealth/status as byproduct. 5) Validate advice by whether later pillars show coherent fruition, not one-off omens.
entries.logic_compare: Pairs with 巍巍不动太山… on ‘结果,’ but foregrounds manifestation of nature rather than mountain-like stillness. More affirmative and completion-oriented than 弘阳叹世经. Relative to 弘阳悟道明心经, it emphasizes verified fruit after mind-illumination, closing the awakening loop with results.

entries.name_han: 弘阳妙道玉华随堂真经
entries.logic_thesis: The wondrous Dao is enacted in regular hall practice (随堂): jade-flower purity is maintained by continual recitation and communal ritual order, not by occasional inspiration alone.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Sublime truth must be embodied in schedule and place. 2) ‘Jade flower’ images refined, pure response of body-mind. 3) Hall liturgy synchronizes individual breath with collective dharma field. 4) Consistency protects against regression into dust. 5) Mystical insight without hall discipline decays. 6) Hence true scripture is lived as recurring performance of order.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For charts weak in routine (scattered Output, no Seal), prescribe fixed ritual hours as Seal-building behavior. 2) Use recurring monthly branches matching the useful god as ‘随堂’ practice anchors. 3) Prefer steady Resource luck for habit formation over explosive Kill years for crash cultivation. 4) Read communal roles (officer, teacher, cantor) as Officer/Seal career expressions of hall order. 5) Track adherence as a measurable ‘god of continuity’ against void and clash interruptions.
entries.logic_compare: More liturgical and institutional than mind-only texts like 正信除疑 or 悟道明心. It operationalizes Hongyang identity in temple time, whereas 临凡飘高经 narrates mythic origin. Compared with 销释木人…, it assumes an already-open teaching hall rather than dramatizing conversion of the ‘wooden person.’

entries.name_han: 古佛天真考证龙华宝经
entries.logic_thesis: The Ancient Buddha / Heavenly Truth authenticates the Dragon Flower assemblies: cosmic history runs through three assemblies of salvation, and present teaching is the verified vehicle for late-age rescue.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Sacred history is periodic, not random. 2) Dragon Flower sessions mark staged universal salvation. 3) ‘考证’ claims scriptural-historical verification of this timetable. 4) Beings must recognize which assembly and which dharma door apply now. 5) Misidentification of the age leads to wrong practice. 6) Correct alignment with the Longhua schedule is itself the logic of hope and urgency.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Treat life as assembly-stages: setup (youth Resource), test (Officer/Kill midlife), fruition (later Seal/Wealth coherence). 2) Time major vows and conversions to luck that matches ‘assembly opening’ (combinations unlocking sealed storage). 3) Read apocalyptic anxiety in charts as Kill without Seal; antidote is verified framework (Seal) not more panic action. 4) Use generational stem comparisons for family ‘which assembly’ narratives carefully, as metaphor not fatalism. 5) Prioritize teachings/remedies that restore orderly sequence over chaotic multi-sect stacking.
entries.logic_compare: This is a key eschatological charter for popular Buddhist-Daoist sectarian currents, broader than single-descent Hongyang origin tales. Versus 闽都别记, time is cosmic-assembly time, not local historical anecdote. Against quietist ‘no cultivation’ baojuan, it insists on timely participation in a verified salvation schedule.

entries.name_han: 销释木人开山显教明宗宝卷
entries.logic_thesis: The ‘wooden person’ (inert, unawakened being) is broken open so the mountain gate of the teaching can be founded; dissolving delusion reveals the sect’s true lineage and clarifies the orthodox principle (明宗).
entries.logic_chain: 1) Ordinary beings are like wood: formed yet unresponsive to living Dao. 2) ‘销释’ dissolves blockages of ignorance through explanation and practice. 3) Opening the mountain means establishing a teachable path in the world. 4) Manifest teaching (显教) must display clear doctrine, not secret confusion. 5) Clarifying the lineage/principle (明宗) prevents deviant forks. 6) Conversion is thus both personal thawing and institutional founding.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Spot ‘木人’ patterns: strong structure but weak response—abundant Peer/Resource with no Output, or frozen water/wood without fire. 2) Prescribe ‘开山’ years when Output/Fire or Officer appears to animate the static chart. 3) Use explanatory counsel (Seal + Food) to ‘销释’ fixed ideas before talisman stacking. 4) For career, open-mountain timing = starting school/line/brand when useful gods combine. 5) Verify 明宗 as one coherent useful-god strategy; reject contradictory multi-school remedies that re-confuse the client.
entries.logic_compare: More conversion-and-founding oriented than 叹世 lament or 悟道 pure mind-clearing. Shares ‘显/明’ vocabulary with 显性结果 and 明心 texts but stresses wooden inertia and gate-opening imagery. Relative to 龙华宝经, it is less about three cosmic assemblies and more about making a specific teaching lineage intelligible and active in persons.
